Represents 50,000 Class A Ordinary Shares underlying restricted stock units ("RSUs"). The reporting person, jointly with Golnar Abivardi, owns the RSUs as tenants in common. All of these RSUs are deemed to be beneficially owned by the reporting person. RSUs were granted and fully vested on the date hereof. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one Class A Ordinary Share and has no expiration date.
